changed: Added a plain answer on install size for each console, including a 512 GB Series S, with how to check free space and how to make room.
Added step-by-step crash help for PS5 and Xbox, from PlayStation's and Xbox's own support pages.
Boxed-copy code answers now link to Rockstar's activation help and its support request form.
Checked every Official answer against the page it cites, and re-labelled answers that only had news or console-maker sources.
Unlock time now cites Rockstar and the console makers only. The US time-zone times, which come from a news report, have their own Reported answer, and so does the report of sealed boxes with no code.
The install-size answer now gives the usable space on a 512 GB Series S and links the answer behind it. The frame-rate answer now gives the measured dips and input lag.
Before you start now runs in the order each step depends on: redeem the code, update the console, free the space, turn on automatic downloads, check the countdown.
Spelled out what each spoiler setting holds, moved a few gameplay sentences behind Mild, and put jargon after a plain phrase.
The default spoiler setting now shows only the basics: setup, settings, controls, saving and fixes. How the game's systems work in play moved behind Mild.
Added one answer on what you can lose: uninstalling, saves and carried cash, with what nobody has confirmed yet.

The two unlock-time answers now say where Rockstar and a news report disagree, and which says which. The install-size answer cites official pages only; the Series S usable-space figure stays in its own reported answer.
Sources can be marked for one console, so an answer can show the sources that match yours.
Launch day has come: steps that only made sense before launch were reworded.
